name: AntiVenom Hub
changelog: NFL: live games show green LIVE and sit at the top; the list refreshes every 2 minutes
NFL: one row per game (RedZone + today's matchups) instead of 30 identical NFL LIVE scraper tiles
NFL: slate auto-writes every 2 minutes from the real feed and ESPN scores (LIVE / Final / kickoff)
NFL: each game uses that team's ESPN logo; home/away picture flips every week
Fixed: GameDay no longer sits on a days-old empty cache saying 0 LIVE while Sunday football is on
GameDay now refreshes real ESPN scoreboards on a timer and keeps the last good file if a fetch fails
Fixed: Multi-tiered metadata resolver with TMDb ID, Cinemeta, TMDb Search, and TVMaze ensures no title ever fails to find streams due to missing IMDb IDs or Cinemeta timeouts
Fixed: Fast Mode passes tmdb IDs directly to DebridEngine and The Crew fallback, instantly resolving streams for Disney+ specials, obscure releases, and franchise films
Added: Direct metadata entries for The Wonderful Autumn of Mickey Mouse and Disney+ seasonal specials
Added: Unified streaming studio network IDs for HBO Max (HBO + Max Originals), Paramount+ (Yellowstone + Showtime), Peacock (NBC + USA), MGM+ (FROM), and Starz
Added: FX on Hulu and network studio routing for Snowfall, The Bear, Fargo and other FX/Hulu exclusives
Added: Featured crime drama collection including Snowfall, Power, The Wire, Sicario, American Gangster, Training Day and Boyz n the Hood
Fixed: Debrid resolver direct fallback queries Real-Debrid instant cache for TV show packs and vintage seasons
Fixed: Live sports dynamic badges and header HUD dynamically reflect in-progress games

Sports now stream through Mad Titan Sports. Live games, College, Pros, Replay games and the Home sport cards open Mad Titan's NFL, college, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, UFC, boxing, WWE, racing, tennis and golf lists. Opening Sports installs it automatically the first time (about 1 minute). Movies and TV still use The Crew
Search: partial or misspelled titles now find the closest match ("james and the giant" finds James and the Giant Peach)
Fixed: The crash reporter no longer reports old errors from before the update, or a crash when the device went to sleep
Sports: scheduled games stay on the Live list, and each live feed is listed separately instead of being merged into one
Sports: Live NBA (and the other leagues) lists every live feed, not the single future game on the ESPN board
Sports Live now lists every sport (NFL, college, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, UFC, F1, NASCAR, boxing, WWE, tennis, golf). It no longer hides a sport just because a game is not in progress
Fixed: Pros and Live streams no longer crash with name '_query' is not defined. That crash hit every sport
Sports: every league's Live games, College, Pros, and Replays stay on that sport. UFC no longer opens college football, and replays are filtered to the sport you picked
Sports: Live games inside a sport shows that league's games today. Dead Crew links (url 0) are no longer listed
Sports lists now use the Netflix poster wall, the same image view as Movies and TV
Sports: UFC, NFL, NBA and the other sport cards are back. Opening a sport shows Live games, College, Pros, and Replay games
Fixed: Install / Repair The Crew now installs The Crew, its module and all 15 helper add-ons by itself (about 1 minute) — no more manual install on Fire TV
Fixed: Real-Debrid pairing no longer crashes with 'No module named six' on a new stick
Fixed: A TV special is no longer looked up as season 0 of the main show, and broken Crew episode links no longer open the wrong list
Sports: just four choices — Live games, College, Pros, Replay games. Streams are listed as Stream 1, 2, 3 instead of (RS)/(SC) codes
Speed: New Debrid engine — Play asks Torrentio for Real-Debrid instant copies only and starts the best 1080p/720p file in a few seconds (like Stremio)
Added: Comet is the automatic backup when Torrentio has nothing that plays; Real-Debrid's own check is used if both are down
Speed: Holding focus on a Home movie poster fetches its stream list in the background, so Play starts almost instantly
Added: Streams that fail are remembered and skipped next time; the file that worked is still tried first
Added: Settings toggle 'The Crew Backup Search' (ON by default). The Crew only runs when no instant copy is found
Added: If nothing is ready, AntiVenom offers to have Real-Debrid download it and shows progress (cancel keeps it downloading)
Fixed: Search results (movies and TV episodes) now try Real-Debrid first like Home posters; The Penguin had the wrong IMDb id; links with no IMDb id are matched by title + year
Fixed: Gladiator II used the wrong IMDb id, so Real-Debrid always missed it and The Crew search ran
Added: A movie or episode that plays from Real-Debrid is remembered, so the next play skips the search
Added: Fast Mode tries a cached Real-Debrid file first (about 10s) and only opens The Crew search if Real-Debrid has no copy
Added: Fast Mode ON by default — Crew+Classy scrapers, ~8s timeout, RD cached-first, auto-play with 4 automatic stream tries before no-stream
Added: Settings Fast Mode toggle (OFF restores all scraper packs and source picking) plus Optimize for Speed re-apply
Speed: First click on a Movies/TV link goes straight to The Crew again (1.0.22 was scraping twice). The list is cached after you leave, so the next open is instant
Fixed: Check for Updates no longer treats the old GitHub Release (v1.0.11) as latest — it now uses version.json so 1.0.19 sticks are offered 1.0.22
Fixed: Tapping a Home poster no longer aborts The Crew scrape when the script exits
Speed: Movies/TV genre and network lists are cached after the first open so the second open does not scrape from scratch
Fixed: Home row focus no longer shows the section above when Continue Watching is visible (skin 4.0.7)
Fixed: Play Now auto-picks the best stream — no more scrolling through dozens of source links
Fixed: Continue Watching is its own row. It no longer replaces the first trending movie
Speed: Play no longer freezes Home for 60s and then starts a second search
Speed: 1GB sticks no longer prefetch Crew genre lists in the background during updates
Fixed: Play buttons with '&' in the title (Deadpool & Wolverine) did nothing — the title was cut off
Speed: Background Real-Debrid sync every 60s (was 10s); GameDay every 3 minutes; Crew search DB init once
Added: Check for Updates is back in the AntiVenom SETTINGS menu (it had no button in 1.0.17/1.0.18)
Fixed: plugin://script.antivenom/ now returns an empty directory immediately (no install/setup, no GetDirectory crash)
Fixed: Skin install never deletes the live skin folder (Android errno 16/39); existing trees are synced in place
Fixed: Kodi settings are no longer rewritten as XML while Kodi is running (that reset the skin to Estuary)
Speed: Home no longer runs a second system check on every load; the service does it once per session
Speed: Boot no longer copies the entire skin or ReloadSkin unless files are actually missing
Speed: Service no longer runs InstallAddon loops on every boot
Fixed: Setup wizard cache is capped at 40MB on 1GB Fire Sticks (150MB was starving RAM)
Fixed: 4K/10-bit HEVC sources are recapped to 1080p on 1GB sticks (UHD remuxes crash the AFTT decoder)
Fixed: The top-bar SETTINGS button opens the AntiVenom menu
Speed: Ambient auto-play trailers stay OFF by default
